en.headline: Shenzhen Bay Port to stay open until 2am Friday and Saturday nights
en.dek: Passenger and coach clearance will be extended by two hours on 30 and 31 October to ease expected late-night pressure at Huanggang over the Halloween weekend.
body: The Hong Kong government announced on Thursday that Shenzhen Bay Port passenger and coach clearance will remain open until 2am on the nights of Friday 30 October and Saturday 31 October.

The normal closing time of midnight will be extended by two hours on both nights so that services finish at 2am the following morning. The measure is intended to divert late-night cross-boundary passenger and vehicle flows away from Huanggang Port and surrounding roads.

Officials expect higher volumes this weekend because of Halloween, the Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival and major concerts. Late-night hours between 11pm and 2am are forecast to be the busiest period for northbound traffic.

During the extended hours, private cars holding Shenzhen Bay closed-road permits may only use Shenzhen Bay; the existing arrangement allowing them to use Huanggang between 2am and 6:30am remains unchanged. Cars holding permits for other land crossings may continue to use Huanggang in the early morning as usual.

zh.headline: 深圳灣口岸周五六晚延長通關至凌晨兩時 分流皇崗壓力
zh.dek: 港府宣布十月三十及三十一日晚旅客及客車清關由午夜延長兩小時至翌日凌晨二時，以紓緩萬聖節周末深宵跨境人流車流。
body: 港府周四公布，深圳灣口岸旅客及客車清關服務將於十月三十日（星期五）及三十一日（星期六）一連兩晚由原來午夜十二時關閉，延長兩小時至翌日凌晨二時。
有關安排旨在分流深宵時段跨境人流和車流，減輕皇崗口岸及周邊道路的交通壓力。政府預計本周末因萬聖節、香港美酒佳餚巡禮及大型演唱會等因素，訪港旅客及深夜跨境人次將顯著增加。
當局預料每晚約十一時至翌日凌晨二時將是皇崗北行人流及車流最繁忙時段。
延長服務時段內，持有深圳灣口岸封閉道路通行許可證的跨境私家車只可使用深圳灣過關；凌晨二時至六時三十分使用皇崗的現行安排維持不變。持其他陸路管制站許可證的私家車，仍可按原有安排使用皇崗。
